name: Hakuto Co., Ltd.
summary: Hakuto Co., Ltd. procures and sells electronic materials, parts, and equipment in Japan, China, rest of Asia, and internationally. It operates through Products Business, Electronics and Electrical Equipment Business, Chemicals Business, and Other Businesses segments. The company provides semiconductor devices; and electronic components comprising photovoltaic products, connectors, optical measurement, measurement system, cable solutions, video conferencing and TFT-LCD panel, environmental products, IAQ monitor, and RFID solutions, as well as EMI, electronic component, and thermal management solutions.
